finding: Production automatic restart success currently constructs only RestartQueued. The two automatic enum variants are otherwise never constructed in production source.

Both integration tests expect AutomaticRestartBudgetExhausted but also expect an empty fourth-crash TickReport; existing native unit tests and real tick_slot propagation require a RestartBudgetExhausted fault.

semantics.persisted_attempt_source: RestartBudgetError::Exhausted carries state.attempts directly from read_restart_budget after schema, timestamp/window, attempt-bound and pending-state checks; no new read or guessed configuration value.
semantics.queue_order: Existing claim_restart write completes before deadline calculation and both queue events; original RestartQueued retained, new AutomaticRestartQueued follows; exit finalization remains at its original call site.
semantics.exhaustion: Consumes no new attempt, emits the verified stored count, keeps restart_pending false and the existing SupervisorError fault; updates only its in-memory count projection from that same stored value.
semantics.manual_path: Only the pattern for the private error payload changes to { .. }; manual commands, generic event, returned public error and transition order are byte-identical.
semantics.test_changes: Existing backoff/spawn/automatic-event assertions are retained. Only two contradictory fourth-crash empty-report assertions become exact one-fault, matching AgentId and full expected public error string.
semantics.new_unit_test: Two actual durable claims/completions followed by exhaustion: emitted private error count must equal freshly read persistent count, and rejection leaves the persisted state unchanged. This test was prepared, not executed.

consumer_review.automatic_variants: Repository Rust search found only model definitions and these two integration consumers before patch.
consumer_review.generic_event: All existing generic queue constructions retained, including both manual paths.
consumer_review.bounded_history: AgentSlot::event still uses BoundedQueue with unchanged capacity. Main supervisor length assertions require <= 8, not an exact event count.
consumer_review.ordered_existing_test: The MatrixKillRequested-before-KillRequested relative-order assertion is unrelated to automatic restart queue/exhaustion. Existing events are not reordered.
consumer_review.control_digest: Current daemon ControlStateMaterial does not include the events vector. restart_attempt was already in the control-state digest; exhausted projection now reflects the actual stored count.
consumer_review.remaining_limit: Additional automatic event records occupy the same bounded history and can evict older records earlier. No claim of full native consumer validation.

scope_exclusions: No journal format or durable claim protocol change
No authority or permission gate change
No changes to maintenance workflow/source or scientific files
